trans-unit.source: We have it... The Sword of Time...
trans-unit.target: We have it... The Sword of Time...

trans-unit.source: An enemy time traveler's worst nightmare.
trans-unit.target: An enemy time traveler's worst nightmare.

trans-unit.source: Our last remaining duty is to use it on Dhaos.
trans-unit.target: Our last remaining duty is to use it on Dhaos.

trans-unit.source: There's only one problem... Where is the guy?
trans-unit.target: There's only one problem... Where is the guy?

trans-unit.source: That is unclear. There is no trace of him anywhere in the sky, the sea, or on land...
trans-unit.target: That is unclear. There is no trace of him anywhere in the sky, the sea, or on land...

trans-unit.source: Guess we can't just walk up to him on the street, eh?
trans-unit.target: Guess we can't just walk up to him on the street, eh?
